authority.owner_expansion: Low fuel use; expensive diverse processed vehicle materials; iron ore to bars to sheet metal; mine coal; extract crude oil and refine fuel; extraction outside camp; useful vehicles for existing Worlds 2–10. This is normalized from the root task relay, not a verbatim owner quote.
authority.preserved_owner_rules: Prior snow-truck garage/fence, unlimited any-resource cargo, outside loss, garage automatic whole-load deposit and HP rules remain binding.
authority.quantities: Selected engineering fixtures only. No amount, duration or world unlock is playtest balanced.

unit_contract.counts: Canonical nonnegative decimal strings. One count preserves one existing ledger unit; never infer physical stack count.
unit_contract.existing_products: Planks, blocks and meals preserve one legacy product count. Existing saw/quarry use one raw bundle for one product.
unit_contract.new_items: Bars, sheets and components use one authored item count; crude oil/fuel use abstract liquid units, not asserted litres.
unit_contract.migration: Copy exact legacy integer ledger values to strings only under a whole-world versioned migration; retain raw display scale10. No silent multiplication, division or rounding.
unit_contract.raw_cost_table_unit: Legacy bundle counts for wood, stone, metal and coal; authored liquid-unit counts for crude_oil. Do not add unlike physical units as mass.

assumed_existing_capabilities: established expanded camp and safe player return
ordinary construction funding and manual handoff
existing_progression_excluded_from_subto: unlisted prior infrastructure and route restoration
bootstrap.crude_source: Manual pump at reachable outside-camp crude deposit. No engine fuel required for extraction, construction or return. Registered deposits and replenishement schedules remain integration gates.
bootstrap.renewal: At least one attainable replenishable source for each mandatory fuel-chain leaf; resource depletion, blocked route and lost equipment cannot remove the last recovery path.
bootstrap.no_recursion: No machine needs its own output or vehicle fuel to build its first working instance. The proof checks the declared graph, not physical world reachability.
bootstrap.subtotal_ownership: The proof totals all nine listed producer entries once, plus a new garage and truck. The actual quote excludes already-owned producers; never charge them again. Current camp progression, tools and route costs are outside this subtotal.
bootstrap.world1_capability_change: Authored selection: the new World1 truck profile requires access to the listed iron/steel/assembly/oil chain within attainable World1 play before quote admission. Do not require travel to World3 or a vehicle to acquire these inputs. Later desert/volcanic regions deepen ore/steel production and route uses; their theme is preserved without making first steel a mandatory later-world gate.

fuel_contract.usage: Pay authenticated active propulsion/tool use before the corresponding simulation slice. No idle, docked, service, menu, paused, background or closed-app drain; no distance/range promise.
fuel_contract.refuel: Explicit whole-unit source-to-tank transfer while stationary, engine off and tools stopped; source ownership and capacity revalidated. Tank balance is separate from unlimited cargo.
fuel_contract.docking: All ordinary cargo, including cargo fuel, deposits atomically; operating tank stays with vehicle. Full hull and working-tool clearance, stationary and stopped tools required.
fuel_contract.outside_wreck: Remaining ordinary cargo and tank fuel lost exactly once; fractional tank loss has its own exact ledger.
fuel_contract.inside_wreck: Ordinary typed salvage and separate fractional tank estate retained; fuel estate can return only to a live eligible tank, without rounding or duplicate recovery.
fuel_contract.dry_tank: Engine/tool stop safely; no destruction, HP loss or deletion. Driver can exit, manually make/bring fuel, and return; persistent vehicle/cargo remain exposed under ordinary combat rules. No free recovery teleport.
fuel_contract.inside_estate_repurchase: Keep fractional tank estates separate from ordinary vehicle.salvage. Paid replacement must be possible while a fractional estate remains; only afterward claim it into the live replacement tank. Never combine the estate with Build14 vehicle_repurchase salvage-empty precondition, which would deadlock no-live-tank recovery. Preserve estate owner, wreck generation and one-claim receipt.

purchase_policy.new_quote: Admit only after actual producer, material source, route, garage and current progression proofs establish the entire unpaid obligation attainable; freeze catalogue, unit schema, complete bill, starter fuel, target/generation and contribution escrow.
purchase_policy.funding: In the new purchase receipt debit the full frozen bill; transfer exactly initial_tank_fuel_units from the bill fuel line to tank, record every other paid input as construction spend. No double-spend or hidden free tank.
purchase_policy.old_quotes: Keep accepted and partially contributed legacy bills and target history unchanged; finish them with the same unpaid obligation. An old quote lacking funded starter fuel creates an empty tank.
purchase_policy.old_vehicles: Preserve paid vehicle ownership, HP, cargo, upgrades, quote terms, generations and existing debt; add empty tank explicitly. No retroactive construction fee or free fuel.
purchase_policy.replacement: Destroying/rebuilding uses typed generation change and eligible paid replacement. No automatic resurrection or quote reroll. Replacement affordability is revalidated through manual recovery chains.
purchase_policy.dynamic_costs: Progression/target-tier curve may select future amounts before admission; owned wealth and paid history do not raise the price. This fixture supplies a bill shape, not the final curve.

migration.metal_id: Retain metal as stable saved ore ID. Display Iron ore only through explicit catalogue/recipe version migration and corresponding art/tooltip update. Do not create a second iron_ore balance or auto-convert ore to bars.
migration.steel: Retain existing steel if any. This authored iron-bars+coal refining branch supersedes the earlier design-only direct ore+coal steel shortcut for new recipe versions; complete existing in-flight recipe receipts under their original version.
migration.fuel: Existing registered fuel salvage becomes the same usable fuel resource only after semantic/provenance reconciliation; crude_oil remains distinct raw stock. Never equate coal with fuel.
migration.all_custody: Migrate player, workers, truck, warehouse, machine input/output, belts, escrow, sales, loose drops, salvage, tank estates, lost/spent histories and quotes in one atomic world save. Preserve stable transaction/tombstone identities.
migration.failure: Stage and validate before activation; unsupported/malformed state fails with old save intact. Rollback/retry is idempotent.
migration.runtime_status: No game migration, producer or outside-oil source is implemented by these files.
migration.live_adapter_seams: Build14 configure/payment/vehicle_repurchase/vehicle_pay_repair/_move_vehicle_goods and restore use fixed raw/planks/blocks/meal/money schemas and native ints. Catalogue additions alone are insufficient: replace coupled payment, ownership, display, cargo/warehouse and restore dispatch with exact typed custody. field_progression.price_text omits new IDs and scales all non-plank/block kinds by10; use catalogue-specific denominations and exact decimal formatting.

preserved_boundaries.camp: Keep original fence collision until one atomic completed garage-door replacement; retain two usable bidirectional pedestrian openings and initial camp scale.
preserved_boundaries.combat: Safe camp travel uses stopped tools. Deliberate eligible hostile defense remains a selected integration requirement; no incidental friendly/owned-structure damage. Dock/service/unload always stops tools.
preserved_boundaries.cargo: Any registered resource, arbitrary exact logical count. All-resource unbounded warehouse receipt or whole-load HOLD/retry; no mandatory extra conveyor and no finite vehicle weight/slot cap.
preserved_boundaries.u3: Self-service counter; eligible living unlocked-worker bulk work/cash/jobs and hunting; camp vulnerability; useful attacking pets; paid actor/equipment recovery; furnace-blackout manual recovery; named-camp raid scope and300-second active warning; paused background simulation.
preserved_boundaries.progression: Capability-gated quotes only; no arbitrary level. Preserve T01–T70 and leave missing T71–T80 undefined.

verification_claim: verify_economy.py checks catalogue identifiers, positive recipes, acyclic dependencies, funded tanks, multi-use components and material bootstrap. It does not prove navigation, mining contact, fuel balance, device behavior, animation, economy fun or runtime integration.
